datePolicy: All cited access dates retain 2026-11-07 from the assigned ledger; editing is not a source refresh. March 2027 is future planning. Supplier departure samples, publication dates and expired offer windows are not availability claims.

planningAssumptions.profile: Retired South Korean passport-holding couple from Busan, both 66; Vietnam arrival 2027-03-03 and departure 2027-03-17, not Korea flight dates.
planningAssumptions.route: Hanoi–Ha Long overnight–Hanoi–Hue–Hoi An via Hai Van–HCMC with Mekong day trip
planningAssumptions.budgetStatus: All caps are unquoted two-person allowances. Hold fixed VND basket for FX sensitivity; no multi-currency forecast. Round VND totals to nearest won half-up. International airfare, shopping, major uninsured medical bills and extra international-flight nights excluded. Avoid double-counting included cruise transfers, meals or sights.

uncertainties: No March 2027 all-in two-person hotel/cruise quote, availability or selected flight schedule/baggage; dates and offers are dated examples only.
Cruise dawn-program opt-out, staying aboard and later breakfast are essential unresolved pacing conditions; protect Hanoi buffer and no consecutive early starts.

Korean passport exemption and Korea-issued insurance assumptions do not transfer to Chinese-speaking readers of other nationality/residence. Recheck entry/PAI near travel; PAI compulsory status/timing and live e-visa tariff unresolved.
Primary absolute rail fares are unverified; reseller/newspaper examples remain unconfirmed. Heritage train own-page schedules conflict; car detailed scenic surcharge conflicts with marketing.

Paradise USD330/cabin does not establish two adults or cabin category; conditional total only. Dragon Legend agency cruise/transfer price must not inherit operator-package transport inclusion. Bai Tu Long is not central Ha Long.

Hotel seasonal examples are not March offers: Hanoi USD inference and ++, Hue one-guest meal, Victoria two-night average, expired Lantana and New World extras/nonrefundable terms retained. Caps may fail.

Hotel elevator/shower access and boat boarding suitability unverified; small boat/speedboat is not automatically easy. Insurance eligibility is not acceptance or evacuation coverage; KRW200000 is reserve, not premium.
15% contingency and extra headroom do not guarantee budget fit; FX sensitivity holds VND constant. Original clean-session process exception remains unresolved.
